title: Folio: Recoverable Multi-Resolution Context Folding for Long-Horizon Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.16627v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon language agents accumulate tool results and replies until the history no longer fits the context window. Current agents shrink this history by having a model summarize it, so each compaction rereads and rewrites the history it replaces, and cache-aware triggers decide when to compact while taking the size of the result as given. We present Folio, a context manager that records, folds, and recovers history through one set of handles. While the agent runs, Folio records three linked levels: a short turn note the model writes as part of its ordinary reply (L1), an event manifest of every call written by the runtime (L2), and the captured source records (L3). Because these views already exist, the runtime folds the context programmatically, selecting coarser views for older turns. translated_title: Folio：面向长程语言代理的可恢复多分辨率上下文折叠
translated_abstract: 长程语言代理会不断累积工具结果与回复，直到历史记录超出上下文窗口的容量。当前的代理通过让模型对历史进行摘要来缩减历史，因此每次压缩都需要重新读取并重写它所替代的历史，而缓存感知的触发器在决定何时压缩时则将结果的大小视为给定条件。我们提出了Folio，一个通过一组句柄来记录、折叠和恢复历史的上下文管理器。在代理运行时，Folio记录三个相互关联的层级：模型作为普通回复一部分写下的简短回合笔记（L1）、由运行时写入的记录每次调用的事件清单（L2），以及被捕获的源记录（L3）。由于这些视图已经存在，运行时能够以编程方式折叠上下文，为较旧的回合选择更粗粒度的视图。折叠操作会打印索引L2和L3的句柄，使得恢复工具可以读取有界的页面、对文件中的全文进行计算，并将发现保存（原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: Folio提出了一种可恢复的多分辨率上下文折叠机制，通过回合笔记、事件清单和源记录三个层级以编程方式折叠长程语言代理的历史上下文，并允许通过句柄恢复被折叠的信息，避免了传统摘要压缩方式反复重读和重写历史的开销。
en_tdlr: Folio introduces a recoverable multi-resolution context folding mechanism that programmatically folds long-horizon agents' history through three linked levels of records (turn notes, event manifests, and source records), enabling recovery of folded content via handles and avoiding the costly re-reading and re-writing of history inherent in summarization-based compaction.
